function.name: tasks
function.description: The boss's task and reminder list (single-admin to-dos). Use action=create whenever Error404 asks you to remember, remind, schedule, or note a task or to-do. Use action=list to show open tasks, action=search to find one, action=update to edit it, action=complete to mark it done, and action=delete to remove it. When a task has a time or day, resolve it to an exact ISO-8601 dueAt first (call get_datetime if you need today's date).

action.description: create, list, search, update, complete, delete, or get. Default list.

id.description: Task id, required for update, complete, delete, and get.

title.description: Short task title. Required for create.

details.description: Optional longer notes or context for the task.

dueAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 datetime for when the task is due, for example 2026-02-14T09:00:00+01:00.

status.description: pending, in_progress, done, or cancelled. Used by update.

tags.description: Optional tags such as work, personal, urgent.

query.description: Search text for action=search (matches title and details).

limit.description: Maximum results for list or search. Default 20.
